target: acceptance 1 — a bare sweep where some suites skip but at least one case runs stays green
cmd:
mkdir -p c
mkdir -p c/only_live
cat > c/only_live/live-1.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "live-1", "target": "synthetic", "kind": "headless-agent", "agent": "loop-reviewer", "input": {"brief": {"objective": "noop"}}, "checks": [{"type": "exit_code", "equals": 0}]}
CASEEOF
mkdir -p c/real
cat > c/real/r-1.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "r-1", "target": "synthetic", "kind": "bash-unit", "cmd": "echo '{}'", "checks": [{"type": "exit_code", "equals": 0}]}
CASEEOF
EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{"code":%s}' $?
